# caramelo

**Caramelo** is a comprehensive, production-ready web framework for Rust that combines simplicity with power. Built on top of VeTiS, it provides everything you need to build modern web applications - from REST APIs to full-featured web services - with a clean, intuitive API that makes development a joy.

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
caramelo = { version = "0.1.0" }
```

## Quickstart

```rust
use caramelo::{expect, matchers::eq, assertions::Is};

/// Test equality matcher

#[test]
fn test_equal() {
    expect(1).to_be(eq(1));
}

#[test]
#[should_panic(expected = "Expected 1 to be equals to 2")]
fn test_not_equal() {
    expect(1).to_be(eq(2));
}

/// Test is assertion

#[test]
fn test_is() {
    "a".is("a");
}

#[test]
#[should_panic(expected = "Expected a to be equal to b")]
fn test_is_panic() {
    "a".is("b");
}
```
